artist: Camila Nebbia (feat. Marilyn Crispell & Lesley Mok)
excerpt: With great cooperation between the Americas, two US improvisers — pianist Marilyn Crispell and drummer Lesley Mok — join with Argentinean tenor saxophonist Camila Nebbia for set of free-form improvisations. Without any preset ideas, the pianist, drummer, and saxophonist immediately clicked, propelling eight transformative tracks.

A two-disc release from La Casa and López that shares nothing overtly in common. La Casa has been, for a good quarter century now, one of the finer, most imaginative creators working with field recordings, often concentrating on urban environments, especially the quotidian sounds encountered routine
